Name: Desert Festival Villager Shops Fix
Author: mitekano23
Description:
- MOD Contents
The Villager Shops at Desert Festival have a random element to the Villager in charge, so there are many times when an item you want is not available for purchase.
For this reason, we have made a change to sell items and rare items that are only available here to other villagers, although they will be more expensive than usual (Pricing and availability of sales can be adjusted in the settings).
In addition, items that can be purchased from the person remain at the regular price.
However, they do not try to sell everything. For example, Abigail will not open her store on the first day, so other villagers will not sell Abigail-related goods on the first day.
If you want all the items, make sure to attend the 3-day festival.
Please check the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Desert_Festival#:~:text=at%2012%20pm.-,Villager%20Attendees,-Like%20the%20Night]official wiki[/url] to see who participates in the festival (and does not open stores) on which days.
